description: Security rules for Python files — prevents eval/exec, unsafe deserialization, shell injection, and secrets

code-injection.description: Rules preventing code injection in Python

rules.description: No eval() or exec() — arbitrary code execution risk
rules.message: eval()/exec() allow arbitrary code execution — parse input safely instead

rules.description: No subprocess with shell=True — shell injection risk
rules.message: shell=True passes command to the shell — use list arguments instead to prevent injection

rules.description: Pickle deserialization of untrusted data allows RCE
rules.message: pickle.load/loads on untrusted data allows remote code execution — use JSON or a safe format

secrets.description: No hardcoded secrets in Python files

rules.description: No hardcoded API keys, tokens, or passwords
rules.message: Hardcoded secret detected — use os.environ or a secrets manager
